verdict.rationale: Brave documents a single API surface with pre-extracted content, an LLM Context endpoint 'built for machine consumption' for agents, and AI-powered summarization/synthesis via an official MCP server, covering search+extract+synthesize in one API. However, community evidence indicates the standard/free plan ToS explicitly prohibits using responses for AI inference, requiring a separate AI Inference plan to legally use it in agent workflows — a significant real-world caveat.
